subject: Request: Surgical HC Triage & Temporary Backfill for Model Serving Team
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Surgical HC triage request — Model Serving (promotion + coverage)

Team,

Heads-up: Priya (Sr ML Engineer on Model Serving) accepted the Group Lead role on the Serving org, effective 2027-07-15. This is great for the product velocity work, but it leaves a critical IC gap on the model-serving inference path during the last sprint before our Q3 low-latency launch.

Asking for a short, surgical freeze exception / temporary backfill for up to 6 weeks while we onboard a replacement (contract-first, perm-after). Proposed plan (attached: surgical-triage-plan.xlsx):
- Move one SRE IC from Infra->Serving rotation for 4 weeks (minimizes disruption)
- Post a 6-week contractor req immediately (req-template is attached for PeopleOps)
- Prioritize internal candidates for a faster ramp; external contractor if no viable internal match by week 1

Tradeoffs:
- Cost: ~6 weeks of contractor spend (~$30k) charged to infra migration budget (code 430-ML-INFRA).
- Risk: Slight SLA exposure for infra tools while SRE is borrowed — mitigated by overlap and on-call schedule tweaks.
- Performance reviews: Priya was slated for a merit adjustment in the next cycle; promotion was accelerated. This is not a headcount increase, just a redistribution + temporary slot.

Requesting: leadership sign-off for a temporary backfill + freeze exception to publish a contractor req and authorize the rotation by 2027-06-30.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Director, Serving Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: surgical-triage-plan.xlsx, org-chart-q3.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Surgical HC triage request — Model Serving (promotion + coverage)

Connor — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I escalate for approval:

1) Can you confirm the exact SLA delta we should expect (p50/p95 token latency impact) while the SRE is rotated out? Need a short blurb for Finance and Security review.
2) If contractor-first is the path, can Talent/Contracting confirm time-to-fill estimate? We can't afford >3 weeks without coverage.
3) Please add the compensation & cost line (contract rate assumptions) into the attached sheet — Finance needs the chargeback line item.

I'll put this in front of Markus with a recommendation to approve a 6-week exception conditional on the mitigation items above. PeopleOps — can you stand up a contractor req from the attached template and flag any comp approvals we should loop in?

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering --- Model Platforms
Redwood Inference

Laura / Connor — after reviewing the plan and the risk mitigation notes, I approve a time-limited (max 6 weeks) freeze exception and temporary backfill under the following conditions: 

1) Contractor-first approach; contracting team to provide signed SOW and not-to-exceed cost cap of $35k. Any variance > $35k requires pre-approval.
2) Chargeback to infra migration budget (430-ML-INFRA) and finance notified before posting.
3) SRE rotation coverage plan must include a written on-call handover and a temporary escalation path (handover doc referenced in drive link).
4) PeopleOps to post contractor req immediately after this thread is filed in HR-1123 and confirm shortlist no later than 5 business days.
